svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Multi-account OU structure on AWS subtitle: The organizational units the AWS multi-account guidance recommends, with their accounts, under the management account kind: tree groups: org: { type: aws:generic, icon: aws:organizations, label: AWS Organizations } # The guidance groups Security and Infrastructure as the foundational OUs. foundation: { type: aws:generic-dashed, label: Foundational OUs, in: org } nodes: root: { icon: aws:organizations-management-account, label: Management account, note: Organization root, in: org } security: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Security OU, in: foundation } infra: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Infrastructure OU, in: foundation } workloads: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Workloads OU, in: org } sandbox: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Sandbox OU, in: org } suspended: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Suspended OU, note: Closed accounts, in: org } log-archive: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Log Archive, note: Central logs, in: foundation } tooling: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Security Tooling, note: Delegated administrator, in: foundation } network: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Network, note: Transit and DNS, in: foundation } shared: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Shared Services, note: Platform tooling, in: foundation } prod: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Prod OU, in: org } test: { icon: aws:organizations-organizational-unit, label: Test OU, in: org } developer: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Developer A, note: Sandbox account, in: org } workload-prod: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Workload A, note: Production account, in: org } workload-test: { icon: aws:organizations-account, label: Workload A, note: Test account, in: org } edges: - root -> security, infra, workloads, sandbox, suspended - security -> log-archive, tooling - infra -> network, shared - workloads -> prod, test - sandbox -> developer - prod -> workload-prod - test -> workload-test

svg.title: Multi-account OU structure on AWS
svg.desc: Multi-account OU structure on AWS. 15 components in 2 groups. Connections: Management account to Security OU; Management account to Infrastructure OU; Management account to Workloads OU; Management account to Sandbox OU; Management account to Suspended OU; Security OU to Log Archive; Security OU to Security Tooling; Infrastructure OU to Network; Infrastructure OU to Shared Services; Workloads OU to Prod OU; Workloads OU to Test OU; Sandbox OU to Developer A; Prod OU to Workload A; Test OU to Workload A.

text.tspan: The organizational units the AWS multi-account guidance recommends, with their accounts, under the management account
